findings.status: FIXED by the L1 during this seat
findings.title: the wave tooling pinned the pre-amendment freeze c3e2ca9, which deciding-run.sh refuses
findings.evidence: build-spec-w1.py:8, build-spec-w2.py:12, build-spec-w3.py:14 all set FREEZE = "c3e2ca9f020776b3d66c7af854fb82c834674fcf"; spec-w1.json and spec-w2.json carry the same SHA in their context string. deciding-run.sh:92-93 pins the freeze to the last commit that touched freeze.json at REV. Running the real deciding-run.sh at C0 with FREEZE=c3e2ca9 prints 'DECIDING_REFUSED freeze-not-last-manifest-commit c3e2ca9f020776b3d66c7af854fb82c834674fcf' and exits 3, before any counter runs; with FREEZE=21eb3c6 it reaches the next gate ('control-receipt-missing', expected since the control receipts do not exist at C0). contract.json declares deciding_invocations: 1, so the refused first invocation is spent.
findings.impact: the wave-3 FROZEN_UNCHANGED seat task (build-spec-w3.py:95) would run 'git diff c3e2ca9 PIN -- <paths>' which prints the 7-file amendment diff and reports a false 'instruments changed without an amendment' against a legitimately amended freeze; and the deciding run would be spent on a refusal.
findings.fix_applied_by_l1: build-spec-w3.py:14 now reads FREEZE = "21eb3c63cd0f3190c0deeb8953c6c91c7742cd68" (mtime 16:40:34, after this seat's first report); .ufo/waves/round-56/integration/freeze-pointer-preflight.stdout independently records 'last=21eb3c6... old_matches=false updated=21eb3c6... updated_matches=true'
findings.residual: build-spec-w1.py:8 and build-spec-w2.py:12 still carry the old SHA, but both waves are already dispatched and built (spec-w1.json, spec-w2.json exist); those generators cannot produce wave-3's spec and cannot re-poison the deciding run

findings.title: before/c2.stdout is stale against the amended gate; the wave-3 'run it at the freeze and confirm it matches before/c2.stdout' task cannot pass as written
findings.evidence: before/c2.stdout (committed at C0) records 'arm1-selftest exit=0 14/14' and 'C2_R56: rev=c3e2ca9f0207 selftest=14/14 ... total=2'. Byte diff of the C0 c2/measure.py's own output against the committed receipt: at c3e2ca9 -> diff lines 0 (byte-identical); at 21eb3c6 -> diff lines 8 ('EXPLAIN arm1-selftest exit=0 19/19' and 'C2_R56: rev=21eb3c63cd0f selftest=19/19 ... total=2'). build-spec-w3.py:68 still reads 'Then run it at the freeze `{FREEZE}` and confirm it matches `{E}/before/c2.stdout`', and {FREEZE} now interpolates 21eb3c6.
findings.impact: the wave-3 seat runs the counter at 21eb3c6 and gets 19/19, then compares it to a receipt that says 14/14, and reports a false mismatch against a correct receipt. The comparison the seat is told to make cannot succeed.
findings.fix: either the seat instruction names c3e2ca9 explicitly as the revision the before-receipt was taken at (the correct semantic: the before receipt reproduces at the original freeze), or before/c2.stdout is re-taken at 21eb3c6; both are L1 decisions on a committed receipt and were not edited by this seat
